name: someda
description: Describe a circuit in conversation; get a fab-ready PCB. Claude plans the circuit as a strict JSON contract (per-net frequency, per-component power), then the compiled someda engine deterministically places, autoroutes with 50-ohm-where-needed physics, audits SI/thermal against JLCPCB's real materials and scope, verifies through kicad-cli, and exports Gerbers + drill + BOM. The honest-done contract gates every stage.
